title: "Frequency of prioritized TCR clonotypes in the TIL single-cell data"
author: "Endika Prieto <endikaprieto@vhio.net>"
date: "2026-11-13"

# setup

For each clonotype of the prioritization tables, counts the cells carrying the same TCR in the single-cell data of
the TILs of the same patient (CITE-seq object in `til-data/`; sorted PD1+ and PD1dim fractions, not the experimental
conditions) and adds the result to the tables.

The following columns are added to every `patients/<patient>/deconv/tcr/prioritized_<compartment>_tcrs_for_validation.tsv`,
as `cells of the clonotype / TIL cells of the patient with a TCR (percentage)`:

- `TIL_sc`: both sorted fractions of the patient together.
- `TIL_sc_PD1p`, `TIL_sc_PD1d`: each sorted fraction separately.

Each one is followed by its rank column, `<name>_rank (N=...)`: position of the clonotype among all the TIL
clonotypes of the patient ordered by number of cells (1 = largest; ties share the lowest rank, as in the bulk
rank columns), with N the number of clonotypes detected. The rank is `NA` for clonotypes not found among the TILs.

Two more columns record how each clonotype was matched: `TIL_sc_matched_by` (basis of the match, or the reason
why it cannot be matched) and `TIL_sc_match_key` (the beta-chain key or clonotype identifier searched in the TIL
data of the patient). `tcr-umap-viewer.Rmd` uses them to locate the TIL cells of each clonotype.

`NA` means that the clonotype cannot be matched to the TIL data (see "match"), which is different from `0/N`
(matchable, but not found among the TILs).

The Seurat objects are large: run this on a compute node, not on the front end. Run `tcr-umap-viewer.Rmd`
afterwards to refresh the viewer.

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# --- Define paths ---
# R is started in renv-sturcotte/ (scripts/interactive-R.sh), so ".." is the project folder
project_dir <- normalizePath("..", mustWork = TRUE)
datapath <- file.path(project_dir, "patients")
folder_data <- "deconv"
til_file <- file.path(project_dir, "til-data", "cite1_2_3_4_5_6_8_withoutPat400304_TCR_ADT_virus_singlets.rds")
bulk_file <- file.path(datapath, "clonotypes_adaptive_bulk_productivefreqs_update.rds")   # same file as in petasan .../sturcotte/tcrb/
# --- Parameters ---
patients_sel <- NULL   # NULL = every patient with a prioritization table; or e.g. c("pt3385", "pt3513")
til_prefix <- "^TIL_sc"   # columns written by this script (replaced when it is run again)
til_subsets <- c(TIL_sc_PD1p = "PD1p", TIL_sc_PD1d = "PD1d")
# --- Load libraries ---
library(SeuratObject)
```

# load

Cell metadata of the TIL object. Only cells with a TCR (beta chain) are used; they are the denominator of the
frequencies. `cdr3_j` is the CDR3 beta nucleotide sequence plus the TRBJ gene, the same key used to match the
bulk TCR beta repertoires in `deconv-analysis.Rmd`.

```{r}
til <- readRDS(til_file)[[]]
invisible(gc())
stopifnot(all(c("patient_id", "subset_id", "clonotype", "cdr3_j") %in% colnames(til)))
til <- til[!is.na(til$clonotype) & !is.na(til$cdr3_j), c("patient_id", "subset_id", "clonotype", "cdr3_j")]
stopifnot(all(til$subset_id %in% til_subsets))
# --- One beta chain per clonotype identifier and vice versa, within each patient ---
til_pairs <- unique(til[, c("patient_id", "clonotype", "cdr3_j")])
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(til_pairs[, c("patient_id", "clonotype")]),
  !anyDuplicated(til_pairs[, c("patient_id", "cdr3_j")])
)
bulk <- readRDS(bulk_file)
table(til$patient_id, til$subset_id)
```

Prioritization tables.

```{r}
tables <- list.files(
  datapath,
  pattern = "^prioritized_.*_tcrs_for_validation\\.tsv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)
tables <- tables[basename(dirname(tables)) == "tcr" & basename(dirname(dirname(tables))) == folder_data]
inputs <- data.frame(
  patient = basename(dirname(dirname(dirname(tables)))),
  compartment = sub("^prioritized_(.*)_tcrs_for_validation\\.tsv$", "\\1", basename(tables)),
  table = tables
)
inputs$seurat <- file.path(datapath, inputs$patient, folder_data, "seurat", paste0("obj_", inputs$compartment, "_TCR.rds"))
if (!is.null(patients_sel)) {
  inputs <- inputs[inputs$patient %in% patients_sel, , drop = FALSE]
}
stopifnot(nrow(inputs) > 0, file.exists(inputs$seurat))
inputs[, c("patient", "compartment")]
```

# match

How each clonotype of a table is matched to the TIL cells of the same patient depends on what the deconvolution
object contains:

- **Objects with V(D)J sequences** (`cdr3_nt`, `j_gene`, `chains`; pt3385, pt600280, pt600311): by the exact
  CDR3 beta nucleotide sequence and TRBJ gene (`cdr3_j`), taking the most frequent beta chain of the clonotype,
  as done for the bulk repertoires.
- **Objects without V(D)J sequences** (pt3328, pt3513): by the `clonotype` identifier, and only for identifiers
  that exist in the bulk TCR beta table of the patient. Those identifiers mean the same sequence in every dataset.
  Identifiers above that range were assigned independently in each dataset to clonotypes absent from bulk, so
  the same identifier is a different TCR in the TIL and the deconvolution objects (checked in pt3385, where both
  the identifier and the sequence are available); they are left as `NA`.

```{r}
# --- Most frequent beta-chain key (CDR3 nt + TRBJ) of each clonotype, as in deconv-analysis.Rmd ---
beta_keys <- function(md, id_column) {
  md <- md[!is.na(md[[id_column]]), c(id_column, "chains", "cdr3_nt", "j_gene")]
  keys <- Map(
    function(chain, nt, j) {
      if (anyNA(c(chain, nt, j))) {
        return(character(0))
      }
      chain <- trimws(strsplit(chain, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      nt <- trimws(strsplit(nt, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      j <- trimws(strsplit(j, ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
      if (length(chain) != length(nt) || length(nt) != length(j)) {
        return(character(0))
      }
      beta_idx <- which(chain == "TRB" & grepl("^TRBJ", j) & grepl("^[ACGT]+$", nt))
      paste0(nt[beta_idx], "_", sub("\\*.*$", "", j[beta_idx]))
    },
    md$chains, md$cdr3_nt, md$j_gene
  )
  long <- data.frame(
    id = rep(as.character(md[[id_column]]), lengths(keys)),
    cdr3_j = unlist(keys, use.names = FALSE)
  )
  counts <- stats::aggregate(Freq ~ id + cdr3_j, data = cbind(long, Freq = 1L), FUN = sum)
  counts <- counts[order(counts$id, -counts$Freq, counts$cdr3_j), ]
  counts <- counts[!duplicated(counts$id), ]
  stats::setNames(counts$cdr3_j, counts$id)
}
format_frequency <- function(n, total) {
  ifelse(is.na(n), NA_character_, sprintf("%d/%d (%.2f%%)", n, total, 100 * n / total))
}
add_til_frequency <- function(patient, compartment, table_file, seurat_file) {
  message("--- ", patient, " / ", compartment, " ---")
  til_patient <- paste0("CHUM_", sub("^pt", "", patient))
  til_pt <- til[til$patient_id == til_patient, ]
  if (nrow(til_pt) == 0) {
    stop("Patient not found in the TIL object: ", til_patient)
  }
  # --- Table kept as text exactly as written, so that the existing columns do not change ---
  tcr_table <- read.delim(table_file, colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE,
                          na.strings = character(0), quote = "")
  tcr_table <- tcr_table[, !grepl(til_prefix, colnames(tcr_table)), drop = FALSE]
  id_column <- colnames(tcr_table)[1]
  ids <- tcr_table[[id_column]]
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ids))
  # --- Key of each clonotype in the TIL data ---
  md <- readRDS(seurat_file)[[]]
  invisible(gc())
  stopifnot(id_column %in% colnames(md))
  if (all(c("chains", "cdr3_nt", "j_gene") %in% colnames(md))) {
    method <- "cdr3_j"
    matched_by <- "CDR3b nucleotide sequence + TRBJ"
    unmatched <- "not matchable: no TRB CDR3 nucleotide sequence in the deconvolution object"
    key <- unname(beta_keys(md, id_column)[ids])
    til_key <- til_pt$cdr3_j
  } else {
    method <- "clonotype"
    matched_by <- "clonotype ID (shared with the bulk TCRb table)"
    unmatched <- "not matchable: clonotype ID absent from the bulk TCRb table (not comparable across datasets)"
    stopifnot(id_column == "clonotype")
    bulk_pt <- bulk[[til_patient]]
    if (is.null(bulk_pt)) {
      stop("Bulk sample not found: ", til_patient)
    }
    key <- ifelse(ids %in% bulk_pt$clonotype, ids, NA_character_)
    til_key <- til_pt$clonotype
  }
  # --- Cells of each clonotype among the TIL cells with a TCR, overall and per sorted fraction ---
  # --- Rank among all the TIL clonotypes of the patient (1 = most cells; ties share the lowest rank, as for bulk) ---
  count_cells <- function(cells, column) {
    til_counts <- table(til_key[cells])
    til_ranks <- rank(-til_counts, ties.method = "min")
    n <- as.integer(til_counts[key])
    n[!is.na(key) & is.na(n)] <- 0L
    out <- data.frame(
      frequency = format_frequency(n, sum(cells)),
      rank = as.character(as.integer(til_ranks[key]))
    )
    colnames(out) <- c(column, paste0(column, "_rank (N=", length(til_counts), ")"))
    out
  }
  result <- count_cells(rep(TRUE, nrow(til_pt)), "TIL_sc")
  for (column in names(til_subsets)) {
    result <- cbind(result, count_cells(til_pt$subset_id == til_subsets[[column]], column))
  }
  # --- Basis of the match and key searched in the TIL data ---
  result$TIL_sc_matched_by <- ifelse(is.na(key), unmatched, matched_by)
  result$TIL_sc_match_key <- key
  result[is.na(result)] <- "NA"
  # --- Insert after the bulk repertoire columns ---
  rank_columns <- grep("_rank \\(N=", colnames(tcr_table))
  position <- if (length(rank_columns) > 0) max(rank_columns) else ncol(tcr_table)
  updated <- cbind(
    tcr_table[, seq_len(position), drop = FALSE],
    result,
    tcr_table[, seq_len(ncol(tcr_table))[-seq_len(position)], drop = FALSE]
  )
  # --- Internal controls: rows, order and existing columns are untouched ---
  stopifnot(
    nrow(updated) == nrow(tcr_table),
    identical(updated[[id_column]], ids),
    identical(updated[, colnames(tcr_table)], tcr_table)
  )
  write.table(updated, table_file, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
  matched <- !is.na(key)
  found <- matched & !grepl("^0/", result$TIL_sc)
  data.frame(
    patient = patient,
    compartment = compartment,
    matched_by = method,
    til_cells_with_tcr = nrow(til_pt),
    clonotypes = length(ids),
    matchable = sum(matched),
    found_in_til = sum(found),
    prioritized = sum(tcr_table$Prioritize == "TRUE"),
    prioritized_found_in_til = sum(found & tcr_table$Prioritize == "TRUE")
  )
}
summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(inputs)), function(i) {
  add_til_frequency(inputs$patient[i], inputs$compartment[i], inputs$table[i], inputs$seurat[i])
}))
summary_table
```
